newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Yield on 91 day Cyprus t-bills down at 5.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on 91 day Cyprus t-bills down at 5.47 pct.

text.p: The central bank on Wednesday sold 70.15 million pounds ($139 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills with an average yield of 5.47 percent, down from 5.59 percent at the last auction on March 26.
Bids for bills totalling 91.30 million pounds were made for the 60 million pounds worth of bills on offer. The bank accepted bids for bills worth 70.15 million pounds, a central bank statement said.
Yields ranged from 5.53 percent to 5.39 percent.
